name: Sylex Blast
description: The blast that slaughtered both armies at Argoth, sank the sub-continent and led to the Ice Age.

description_citations.text: "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The war culminates in the Sylex Blast, plunging the world into the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: plunging the world into the Ice Age

citation.text: "Antiquities", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast destroys both armies and Argoth.
timeline.quote: The ensuing Sylex Blast destroyed both armies and the island of Argoth.

citation.text: "Ashnod", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast devours Argoth; Crucias's ship is caught in the blast, ending Crucias's tale and starting Bo Levar's.
timeline.quote: the Sylex Blast devoured the island itself in light.

citation.text: "Bo Levar", section "Captain Crucias". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza unleashes the Golgothian Sylex, slaughtering both armies and sinking Argoth, which ignites his planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: It slaughtered both armies, blasted the landscape for miles, sank the sub-continent of Argoth

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The blast brings a Dark Age of cold, scarcity and persecution of magic.
timeline.quote: The Sylex blast caused a Dark Age on Dominaria.

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Golgothian Sylex and destroys Argoth and its elves.
timeline.quote: ultimately they were all destroyed when Urza activated the Golgothian Sylex

citation.text: "Elf", section "Terisiaran Elves". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast destroys both armies and Argoth, begins the Ice Age and ignites Urza's spark.
timeline.quote: Caught at the epicenter of the blast, Urza's spark ignited.

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast ends the Brothers' War and alters Dominaria's climate, beginning the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: That war ended with the Sylex Blast , which was powerful enough to alter the planet's climate

citation.text: "Ice Age", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Sylex Blast, the Homarids overrun much of the Vodalian territory.
timeline.quote: much of their territory was overrun by the Homarids

citation.text: "Merfolk", section "Vodalian Merfolk". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast cracks the Mori Tumulus with a rift.
timeline.quote: a 500 foot tall, 300 mile long ridge cracked by a rift formed by the Sylex Blast

citation.text: "Terisian Isles", section "Yavimaya". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza releases the Sylex's energy, destroying Argoth and obliterating both armies.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crucias's passengers witness the Sylex Blast; everyone on deck dies except Crucias, who is blinded.
timeline.quote: Everyone on deck dies except Crucias himself, who is blinded by the blast.

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "Expeditions to the End of the World , by J. Robert King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sylex Blast, the climax of the Brothers' War, lofted debris that blotted out the sun and created the Dark.
timeline.quote: The climax of the Brothers' War was the Sylex Blast , which lofted debris into the air blotting out the sun and creating The Dark .

citation.text: "The Dark", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An anti-magic religion came to power, blaming magic and its users for the blast.
timeline.quote: an anti-magic religion comes to power, blaming the Sylex blast and its effects on all magic and its users

citation.text: "The Dark", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza activates the Sylex, obliterating Argoth, turning Urborg to swamp and sending Dominaria into an Ice Age; Urza ascends and Gix retreats to Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
